name: 郭嘉
purpose: 修正旧画过尖的脸型、柔美眉眼和倚靠姿态，重绘清瘦沉稳、骨相明确的成年男性谋士，保留蓝袍军帐与递简构图。
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: revised Guo Jia portrait for a premium Three Kingdoms strategy game. Edit the provided original artwork. Full-bleed vertical composition in a 350:480 aspect ratio, opaque painting, no UI.

The current artwork makes the intended adult male military strategist appear too delicate and languid. Redesign his facial structure, neck, shoulders and seated posture so he reads immediately as an intelligent, lean adult Han Chinese man aged about 32-36. Preserve the original character's blue scholar robes, black cloth scholar headdress, warm campaign tent and sunset camp atmosphere, hand-painted historical illustration style, and the narrative of offering a sealed bamboo dispatch. This is a refined male scholar, not an armored warrior.

Face: clearly mature masculine angular bone structure, a slightly wider squared lower jaw and firm chin, prominent brow ridge, straight strong nose bridge, natural thin lips, deep-set focused eyes and straight substantial dark eyebrows. Natural fine expression lines around the eyes, subtle cheek planes and believable skin texture. Give him a neatly trimmed short moustache and a small close-trimmed pointed chin beard, with realistic sparse stubble along the lower jaw. His features should feel handsome, incisive and understated, not old, bulky or aggressive. No makeup, eyeliner, rosy lips, long decorative eyelashes, smooth doll face, pinched V-shaped chin or glossy beauty retouching. His face is the main focal point, sharply legible even on a small game card.

Expression and posture: an alert, calmly confident strategist assessing an officer just offscreen to the right, a slight knowing tension at the mouth. He sits upright with a slight forward lean and squared open shoulders, head held level, sturdy natural neck, lean male torso visible beneath the robes. Remove the dreamy head-resting-on-hand pose and the languid reclining body. His left forearm rests naturally on the wooden chair arm beside his body; the left hand is loosely relaxed, not touching his cheek. His right arm extends a sealed rolled bamboo dispatch toward the right, right hand firmly holding it with anatomically correct fingers. Exactly two arms and two natural hands. Remove the extra recipient hand entering from the right edge: only one person visible. Both hands and the complete dispatch stay above 72% image height, away from the bottom card label area.

Attire: dark indigo-blue and ink-navy fine silk scholar robes with restrained woven geometric borders, ivory crossed inner collar, natural weighty folds that define upright shoulders and chest. A historically inspired compact black cloth scholar cap with a modest antique-gold clasp, not a woman's hairstyle, tiara or tall crown. Dark hair neatly bound under the cap with a few wind-touched strands. Maintain an austere, tasteful and recognizable male military adviser silhouette, no armor, flamboyant jewelry or magical props.

Setting: a command tent with soft canvas folds framing the figure, restrained amber sunset light, distant army tents and standards in soft focus. Retain a low map table in the lower foreground with a carefully painted terrain map, a few bamboo scrolls and a small bronze oil lamp. Simplify the background and robe details enough for a clear face and silhouette. No second person, no floating hands, no clutter crossing the face.

Art direction: refined Chinese historical ink-and-gouache illustration with confident brushwork, realistic anatomy, subtle paper texture and controlled warm/cool contrast. Clear dark-indigo silhouette against softly luminous beige tent canvas. Maintain consistency with the source painting while improving portrait anatomy and readable facial detail. No photorealistic photography, no glossy 3D, no anime, no airbrushed idol styling, no exaggerated giant muscles, no coarse muddy scratch filter.

Composition: a large seated three-quarter portrait, head and shoulders in the upper half, face inside central safe area away from top corner badges. The bottom 22% contains only less-important map/table or lower robe so the game's title panel will not cover the hands. Fill the whole 350:480 canvas. Absolutely no text, lettering, logos, faction badges, levels, stars, card borders or watermark.
integration: 通过 GeneralPortrait.ts 统一解析郭嘉新版画像，保持配置表原资源标识。
